interactionHelp: Hover to get a reaction. Click to invite. Drag to play. Click elsewhere to return home.
introductionHoverBody: Move your pointer over Mallow for a small reaction.
introductionInviteBody: Click Mallow to invite it out. Click again for a wave or a swing.
introductionDragBody: Drag Mallow to pick it up. Release away from home for a squishy landing.
introductionCatchBody: Hold Mallow near home. When it looks up, release to let it catch. On a screen without a notch, home is at the upper right.
introductionHomeBody: Click elsewhere to send Mallow home. Replay these demos from Help → Meet Mallow in its right-click menu.
introductionReducedMotion: Reduce Motion is on. Each demo shows a still moment.
